back_charge_led_position.note: product photo of the back: a red part between the two screws

base_center_from_axis.note: the turntable sits 4 mm behind the base footprint center

base_drop.note: the base sits this much lower than in the files so the height reaches the published 70.5 mm; the drawing shows the same gap

base_height.note: table to the top of the turntable ring: 0.15 mm plate, 8.0 mm body, 3.1 mm ring

base_mount_holes.note: corner hole spacing across and front to back

battery_size.note: no size is published; a common 550 mAh cell, placed behind the holder back cover

boards.note: only the schematics of the adapter, power, ring and touch boards are published

bottom_plate_below_base.note: the plate seats on the four screw posts

controller_depth.note: 61.5 published depth minus the 46.7 shell; the controller is not in the files

head_depth.note: published drawing; shell file 46.7 mm plus the controller unit

head_front_from_axis.note: the head pockets center on the servo stub; the glass ends 1.26 mm ahead of the base front (drawing: about 1.3)

head_touch_from_pitch_axis.note: in a row under the head top behind the two connector openings, zone 0 at the front; not visible from outside

head_touch_pad_size.note: the pads are under the shell and cannot be seen; only the touch board schematic is published

head_touch_zones.note: firmware head touch code reads three intensities in a row and reports press, release, swipe forward and swipe backward

labels.note: placed from the product photos; print is a stand-in

light_bar.note: light guide file; each bar sits in the slanted slot of a top corner of the shell, stem tip flush

overall_height.note: 70.5 mm published; the files stack to 69.05, see base_drop

power_button_from_pitch_axis.note: read off the published drawing, about 1 mm

reset_button_from_pitch_axis.note: underside photo: 15.0 mm left of the middle, 6.6 mm behind the glass, a white key 7.6 x 5.4 mm in a dark gap; press restarts, hold 3 s enters download mode (product page)

ring_light_from_pitch_axis.note: on the bars (measured); order and spacing along each bar assumed

screen_bottom_led_from_pitch_axis.note: underside photo: the pinhole between the card slot and the reset button, 6.6 mm behind the glass

screen_center_from_pitch_axis.note: read off the published drawing, about 1 mm

screws.note: hole centers fitted in the cover, plate and shell files (holder and head: across, height; plate: across, front to back); head sizes are stand-ins

sd_slot_from_pitch_axis.note: underside photo: 6.8 mm right of the middle, 7.0 mm behind the glass, 12.9 x 1.3 mm

servo_positions.note: the shaft axes are measured; where each case ends is not published
servo_positions.value: pan servo upright on the turn axis with its shaft in the base socket; tilt servo lying on top of it with its shaft on the nod axis

servo_shaft_diameter.note: servo data sheet: 20 teeth, 3.95 mm; the base socket and the arm socket measure the same

servo_size.note: servo data sheet: 23.2 x 12.1 x 25.25 mm, both servos

side_label.note: side photos: 0.9 mm behind the shell front edge, 7.2 mm below the head top

side_openings.note: side photo, about 0.3 mm: width front to back, then height; centers 14.0, 27.5 and 41.7 mm below the head top

usb_c_opening.note: a standard socket (8.3 x 2.6 mm inside) set in the 12 x 5 mm opening of the base file

usb_c_otg_from_pitch_axis.note: read off the published drawing, about 1 mm

usb_c_port_position.note: the opening in the back of the base

frame.origin: yaw axis on the table plane

pitch_axis_height.note: servo holder stub, arm spline and head pocket centers; equals the head's vertical center

pitch_joint.direction_note: positive tilts the face up; 0 is the level pose in the drawing
pitch_joint.geometry_basis: measured: collision sweep of the assembled files
pitch_joint.source: firmware/main/hal/hal_servo.cpp (upstream tree pinned in firmware/BASE), Hal::servo_init angleLimit, tenths of a degree

yaw_joint.direction_note: positive turns toward the robot's right, as the virtual unit view draws it
yaw_joint.published_range: 360 degree servo, no angle restriction (product page)
yaw_joint.source: firmware/main/hal/hal_servo.cpp (upstream tree pinned in firmware/BASE), Hal::servo_init angleLimit, tenths of a degree
